name: Elli and Gray
source: Haruka's most precious treasures who also happen to be her two pet cats. Not much is known about how they came to meet each other but their care amongst each other seems to be solid and well defined. They even communicate with Haruka from time to time using body expressions to show appreciation or to simply request food from her.
